# rzh-vfs golden vectors (parity level P0).
# Generated by tools/differential/gen_vfs_golden.cpp: a verbatim
# transcription of the engine's archive/overlay/routing logic,
# with compressed payloads produced by the REAL EAC RefPack codec
# (refencode.cpp/refdecode.cpp, linked from the game tree).
# Local files are created under a scratch directory by both this
# generator and the Rust replay. '-' is the empty byte string.
# Regenerate with tools/differential/regenerate.sh.

# path keys and orderings
pathkey Data\INI\Weapon.ini data\ini\weapon.ini
pathkey data/INI/weapon.INI data\ini\weapon.ini
pathkey Data\\INI\\X.ini data\ini\x.ini
pathkey a//b/c.txt a\b\c.txt
pathkey - -
pathkey plain plain
pathkey C:\Dir\\File.txt c:\dir\file.txt
pathkey Data\ data\
pathkey Data\INI\..\Weapon.ini data\ini\..\weapon.ini
pathkey UPPER\LOWER\MIXED.TXT upper\lower\mixed.txt
pathkey  FAIL
cmp Data\INI\A.ini data/ini/a.INI 0
cmp a\b a\c -1
cmp a\b a 92
cmp a\b ab -6
cmp - x -120
cmp x - 120
cmp Data\INI\ data/ini 92
cmp Zebra.txt apple.txt 25
